headline: The autopilot loses only what the oracle predicts
lede: Lemmings’ attract demo replayed every command one tick before the solver had verified it — and paid for the drift with two walkers on THE DOOR. The phase law is fixed across sim, attract and WATCH, and the demo’s parachutes are now certified rather than hoped.

notes.text: replay(), the attract loop and WATCH now stamp-apply at the tick solve used: THE DOOR’s attract loses 6/1 — identical to its proof — while SPIRE, MASSIF and LEDGE keep their outcomes and replay-vs-replay stays bit-identical.

The honest world holds its crowds, so the fake crowd-falls that gave the old demo its mid-air canopy are gone — certifyDemoFloat now proves each grant keeps win/exited/dead identical. SPIRE deploys two parachutes mid-descent and DOOR catches its post-bomb drop mid-air.

lemcheck 282 → 314: a REPLAY PHASE section (per-board replay==solve, DOOR silent-at-stamp/live-at-stamp+1 probes, shell source audit) plus a re-phased #3876 plant probe; hand mutation (+1 restored) reddens 5 pins. lemplay 66/66 x2, recmethods 37, goldentracecheck 89/89.
Merged c4ca306 (#3892, never-dry pick). Slot a took #3879’s look slice; idle-kick now answers NONE — the shelf is held or owned.
